name: deliverd
description: Give any AI agent a way to ask a person — for approval, a decision, an answer or a review.

plugins.name: deliverd
plugins.description: Human-in-the-loop for Claude Code: the Deliverd MCP server, six skills — approval (ask a person before a consequential action), tasks (keep long work on its objective), ethics (put concerns about harm to a person in front of whoever decides), artifact (build and publish an HTML page), compliance (do AI work under an organisation's governance, with evidence an auditor can check) and screen (find and redact personal data and secrets before text reaches a model, locally) — and three commands: /deliverd:ask, /deliverd:status and /deliverd:publish. One install.
